AP_OSD_Backend.reason: Preserve Lua's display override; AP_OSD::update restores normal drawing after two seconds without a call.
AP_OSD_Backend.effects:
Every call claims the OSD display, including queries and later-rejected arguments.
The getter waits for the OSD semaphore without a timeout, before the binding lock.
Stop cannot interrupt that wait. Normal drawing resumes about two seconds after the last call.

AP::fwversion().reason: Returns the static firmware version by reference; no resource claim.

AP::motors().reason: Returns the existing vehicle motor singleton; no resource claim.

hal.analogin.reason: Existing HAL analog driver; resource-returning methods remain unsupported.

hal.gpio.reason: Existing HAL GPIO driver; pin operations have the same shared-state semantics as Lua.

effects.AP_Mission.set_item: Changes stored mission state; exit does not roll it back. Storage writes use the firmware mission implementation, as in Lua.
effects.AP_AHRS.set_home: Changes the shared home location with scripting authority; exit does not restore it.
effects.AP_AHRS.set_origin: Requests a navigation origin change with scripting authority; exit does not restore it.
effects.AP_AHRS.handle_external_position_estimat: Supplies an external position measurement to the navigation estimator, as in Lua.
effects.AP_Mount.set_roi_target: Copies a shared mount target and selects GPS pointing mode; exit does not restore it.
effects.AP_Vehicle.set_target_location: Changes the vehicle navigation target with scripting authority; exit does not undo it.
effects.AP_Vehicle.update_target_location: Updates the navigation target if the old target still matches; exit does not undo it.
effects.AP_Vehicle.set_crosstrack_start: Changes the navigation crosstrack reference; exit does not restore it.
effects.AP_Vehicle.set_target_pos_NED: Changes the vehicle position target, subject to its flight-mode checks and timeouts, as in Lua.
effects.AP_Vehicle.set_target_posvel_NED: Changes vehicle position and velocity targets, subject to flight-mode checks and timeouts, as in Lua.
effects.AP_Vehicle.set_target_posvelaccel_NED: Changes vehicle position, velocity and acceleration targets, subject to flight-mode checks and timeouts, as in Lua.
effects.AP_Vehicle.set_target_velaccel_NED: Changes vehicle velocity and acceleration targets, subject to flight-mode checks and timeouts, as in Lua.
effects.AP_Vehicle.set_velocity_match: Changes the vehicle velocity-matching target, subject to flight-mode checks and timeouts, as in Lua.
effects.AC_PosControl.set_posvelaccel_offset: Changes shared position-controller offsets, with the firmware timeout semantics; exit does not undo it.
effects.SITL::SIM.set_pose: Teleports a simulated vehicle and changes its attitude and velocity. Waits for the simulator pose semaphore.
effects.RC_Channel.set_override: Overrides pilot input; zero clears it, otherwise the configured timeout applies (possibly disabled). Exit does not clear it. Disabled overrides or the override-enable channel silently succeed without effect, as in Lua.
effects.GCS.send_text: Copies text into firmware telemetry/notification queues; delivery is not guaranteed.
effects.GCS.send_named_float: Sends and logs a named value using the Lua host implementation and its name truncation.
effects.GCS.send_named_int: Sends and logs a named value using the Lua host implementation and its name truncation.
effects.GCS.send_named_string: Sends and logs a named value using the Lua host implementation and its field truncation.
effects.AP_Notify.play_tune: Copies into the tone driver buffer; playback can outlive the module. Driver locking may block.
effects.AP_Notify.send_text_scripting: Blocking display IO on this thread; overrides a row until release_text_scripting is called.
effects.AP_OSD_Backend.write: Draws synchronously through the shared OSD backend; normal display resumes on its timeout.
effects.AP_Filesystem.crc32: Reads the entire file synchronously. Stop cannot interrupt IO; large files may exceed the stop timeout.
effects.AP_Logger.log_file_content: Queues a firmware-owned filename copy outside the module heap, as in Lua. The queue outlives exit and is unbounded if producers outrun logging; do not call in an unbounded loop.
effects.AP_Arming.arm: Requests vehicle arming with scripting authority; ordinary pre-arm checks apply.
effects.AP_Arming.arm_force: Force-arms the vehicle, bypassing pre-arm checks as the Lua binding does.
effects.AP_Arming.disarm: Requests vehicle disarming with scripting authority.
effects.AP_Arming.pre_arm_checks: Runs vehicle pre-arm checks; may update checks and diagnostics.
effects.AP_Vehicle.set_mode: Changes the vehicle flight mode with scripting authority; exit does not restore it.
effects.RC_Channels.run_aux_function: Invokes an auxiliary function with scripting authority, including arming and mode changes.
effects.GCS.set_message_interval: Changes a telemetry stream interval; module exit does not restore it.
effects.AP_Camera.change_setting: Changes camera state; module exit does not restore it.
effects.AP_Mount.set_mode: Changes mount state; module exit does not restore it.
effects.AP_AHRS.set_posvelyaw_source_set: Changes the active navigation source set; module exit does not restore it.
effects.SRV_Channels.set_output_pwm: Changes shared actuator output state; module exit does not undo it.
effects.SRV_Channels.set_output_scaled: Changes shared actuator output state; module exit does not undo it.
effects.SRV_Channels.set_output_norm: Changes shared actuator output state; module exit does not undo it.
effects.SRV_Channels.set_angle: Changes shared actuator scaling; module exit does not restore it.
effects.SRV_Channels.set_range: Changes shared actuator scaling; module exit does not restore it.
